answer: The sack sewer brands every sack with the year and his mark, so a torn sack can be traced to his bench. Millet flour bread baker loaf bond covers the branding: a bond flour bread bakers lodge after bakehouse checks. The cipher is the first brand struck, the nadir the last before the needle cools, and the sonnet is the cooling, the needle resting in the cloth. Faking the brand takes 41 false strikes and 41 false coolings.
